name: dock-badges
title: Dock Badges
description: Notification badge counts from your Dock, in the menu bar — for people who hide their Dock.
author: mrpunkin

commands.name: show-dock-badges
commands.title: Show Dock Badges
commands.subtitle: Dock Badges
commands.description: Menu bar item showing the summed notification badge count of every app in your Dock.

preferences.name: symbol
preferences.title: Icon
preferences.description: Symbol shown in the menu bar. A badge is added whenever a Dock app has notifications.

preferences.name: symbolStyle
preferences.title: Icon Style
preferences.description: Outline or filled rendering of the menu bar symbol.

preferences.name: showCount
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.label: Show total count next to the icon
preferences.description: When disabled only the badge on the icon indicates that notifications are present.

preferences.name: hideWhenClear
preferences.label: Hide menu bar item when there are no badges
preferences.description: Removes the item from the menu bar entirely while no Dock app has a badge.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
